I am in the film industry (SFX) - but I'm also very interested in technology and particularly AI.  So I kind of have a foot in both camps.


I think the industry will eventuality split into AI & Human generated content. But in the meantime,  the industry as we know it today will be decimated. 


Initially, it will only be the big production companies (Disney, Warners, Universal etc) who will have the budget to make AI Feature Films - but for a while at least, smaller productions will carry on much the same.  However the technology will 'trickle down' as the compute resources get cheaper & the models better.  Much in the same way as VFX has impacted movie making, trickling down to TV and even home PC's.


I love my job - but at the same time, I can't wait to see what's next in the AI space.  I don't think regulation will help - it's coming and it's bigger than any Government or regulation.

While the above sounds negative - I'm optimistic about the future for all of us, including Movie Makers.
